descriptor: Button feedback patterns for product interfaces

voice.summary: Sounds like a design engineer showing you a trick: friendly, a little proud, always clear about what just happened. Copy is tiny because the motion is doing most of the talking.
dos: Describe the state change in a few words
Confirm the result right after the click
Use verbs a person would say aloud
donts: Do not over-explain a one-second interaction
Do not use technical terms in button labels
Do not make confirmations sound alarming

boilerplate: Tapback is a collection of button micro-interactions, from loading morphs to hold-to-confirm rings, that helps teams make every click feel acknowledged and safe.

microcopy.error: Something went wrong. Tap to retry.

logo.note: A small spark of feedback captures the instant a button answers back.
